title: The Miscounted Buns
youtube_title: The Miscounted Buns | Bedtime Story for Kids in English
moral: Telling the truth early makes a small mistake easier to mend.
summary: At a ceramic studio sill above the quiet plaza, Dahlia is tangled up with a bun count that was short by one and easy to shrug and almost hides it. Dahlia tells Grandpa Sol the plain truth, and together they mend what can be mended, with no teasing.
